annotations.title: Copy a shared email-reading rule (hack) into a track

description: Copies a community hack into the person's account and attaches it to a track, mapping its fields to columns by name unless you give a mapping (as in save_hack), then runs the track's Inbox again so messages already waiting become rows (inbox says how many). The copy is theirs; community hacks belong to the community and change only when a share keeps everything they read the same, which copies take by themselves. update_hack_from_community brings in a bigger change.

confirmed.description: Only after the person looked at the rows this hack would make from their waiting emails and said they're right: copies it though they look wrong.

mapping.description: Column key to source, as in save_hack.

name.description: A name for the person's copy; the community hack's name if left out.

name: use_community_hack
